# Copilot instructions for Agent Durbar

This repository is spec-driven (GitHub Spec Kit) and shared by several people and agents. **The rules are in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)** (including "Working as a team": claim an issue, branch `NNN-slug`, never push to `main`; and "Keep docs in sync": update README, docs, spec tasks, a `changelog.d/` fragment (not `CHANGELOG.md`), the spec's `specs-index` block (not a `specs/README.md` row) and screenshots in the same PR, including every linked README and website screenshot that shows the changed screen (`npm run shots:docs`; one it cannot retake goes in its `NO_DRIVER` list with a reason), or open and assign an issue) and the project rules in [.specify/memory/constitution.md](../.specify/memory/constitution.md). Read both before changing anything, and read [docs/agent-notes.md](../docs/agent-notes.md) (what other agents learned; add to it when you learn something others would need). This file is only a pointer.
